name: foreman
description: Plan, contract, track, delegate, and document feature work in a workbench/ folder.

default_output.title: Default output style
default_output.description: Concise (token-efficient, recommended) or Normal. Offered as the default when foreman sets up a new project.

default_git.title: Default git choice for workbench/
default_git.description: committed, ignored, or ask. Offered as the default when foreman sets up a new project.

default_fix_rounds.title: Default fix rounds
default_fix_rounds.description: How many times the main agent sends failed verification feedback back to the worker before putting the task on Hold. 0 disables fix rounds.

default_claude_md.title: Default CLAUDE.md block
default_claude_md.description: yes, no, or ask. Whether foreman adds a short block about workbench/ to the project's CLAUDE.md (or CLAUDE.local.md when workbench/ is git-ignored) when it sets up a new project.
